title: Refactor Nyquist notebook to Makie and remove ControlSystems dependency
body: ### Motivation - Reduce the heavy startup/install cost and runtime coupling introduced by `ControlSystems.jl` by computing frequency responses directly in the notebook. - Replace `Plots.jl`/`GR` polar plotting (which had limited viewport control) with a Makie-based polar view so instructors/students can zoom into regions of the complex plane. - Provide a usable repo entrypoint by adding a concise `README.md` describing the refactor and how to run the notebook. ### Description - Replaced usage of `ControlSystems.jl` and `Plots.jl` with an in-notebook `RationalTF` evaluator (`polyval_desc` / `eval_tf`) that computes `G(jω)` from numerator/denominator polynomials and `ω` grid; implemented in `nyquist_examples.jl`. - Migrated plotting to `CairoMakie` and switched Nyquist rendering to `PolarAxis` with explicit angular and radial limits (`thetalimits`, `rlimits`) and added per-section controls `rmax` and `θzoom` to let users zoom the polar viewport. - Rewrote the interactive layout to build linked Bode magnitude/phase and Nyquist polar panels via `section_figure` and Pluto UI sliders (`ω_idx`, `rmax*`, `θzoom*`) while preserving the original three system sections (`G1`, `G2`, `G3`). - Updated the embedded Pluto project metadata (`PLUTO_PROJECT_TOML_CONTENTS`) to list only the lean dependencies (`CairoMakie`, `PlutoUI`) and replaced the repo `README.md` with run instructions and a summary of the refactor. - Added live readouts to the Bode plot titles: the magnitude plot title shows `|G(jω)|` in dB and the phase plot title shows `∠G(jω)` in degrees at the currently selected frequency, updating automatically as the `ω` slider moves. ### Testing - Ran repository checks and file previews via `git status --short` and inspected `nyquist_examples.jl` and `README.md` to validate the changes were applied; these inspections succeeded. - Attempted a lightweight runtime verification with `julia -e 'Base.include(Main, "nyquist_examples.jl"); ...'`, but the check failed because `julia` is not installed in the execution environment (`julia: command not found`). - Committed the changes on branch `feat/makie-no-controlsystems` and created the PR metadata; the commit succeeded and PR was prepared. ------ Codex Task
